page.content:
Ali Ben Ohashi was the leader of the Zensunni sect which broke away from the teachings of Maometh in 1381 BG. Some evidence, however, indicated that Ohashi may have been the spokesperson for his wife Nisai.

page.overview:
Who is Ali Ben Ohashi?

Ali Ben Ohashi was the leader of the Zensunni sect which broke away from the teachings of Maometh in 1381 BG. Some evidence, however, indicated that Ohashi may have been the spokesperson for his wife Nisai.
